suvichaya_iron_dtl.notes: Slow motion: about 5 video frames per real 1/30 s. Frame numbers are video frames at 30 fps; the club meets the ball on frame 278. px_per_m comes from the ball on the ground at frame 266: 20 px across for 42.67 mm. golfer_height_m is her standing height estimated from the address (1.45 m cap to soles, bent over) and the finish.
